svg.aria-label: BigFleet complete system map: control plane (coordinator Raft group, off the hot path) over an autonomous data plane (clusters, operators, shards, providers, capacity pool).
svg.text: Control plane (Raft coordinator, off the hot path) over an autonomous data plane. Data-plane edges solid grey; control-plane edges blue dashed.
CONTROL PLANE — off the hot path
Coordinator (Tier 1) — single Raft group, single region
pkg/coordinator · hashicorp/raft + BoltDB · slow-changing, ~few MB · the cycle hot path NEVER reads this · Raft = log + snapshots (leader→followers) + votes/acks (TCP :7791)
the only replica that serves RPCs · leader-only by construction
shards map — membership / registry (ID, addr, heartbeat)
providers — out-of-tree provider registry (name, addr, region)
latestSummary · latestShortfalls · pending[] queue · FSM.seq fence
BoltDB raft-log.db + raft-stable.db · FileSnapshotStore (30s / thr 1024) · snapshot export every 5min → SnapshotExportDir
resumes export · fresh fence seq under new term
admin gRPC + SnapshotSave · opt-in mTLS (bigfleet://admin) · leader-only
unschedulable demand drives BigFleet · BigFleet is NOT a scheduler
binds Pod → Node · BigFleet never places pods
registers Node from bootstrap blob (join creds)
stores CRs · serves operator's informer cache
OPTIONAL · 1 CR per Pod (ADR-0039, NOT per-unsched)
Pod watcher / reconciler · buildCRForPod · status stamper
resources · priority · interruption+reclamation penalty · coLocation → Same
holds exactly ONE bidi Shard.Session · reconnect loop (500ms→30s)
rollupLoop under errGroup · mTLS URI SAN bind (ADR-0048)
outbox (bounded 256, drop-newest: bootstrap resp / reclaim ack)
lists CRs (informer cache) · buildRollup aggregates by
controller-runtime cache client (in-process informer) · in-cluster k8s API
Shards (data plane) — horizontally scaled, ~500K machines each
autonomous cycles · pkg/shard MUST NOT import pkg/coordinator · topology never crosses shard boundary
reconcile loop (List + Get → Inventory · no Watch)
full or incremental (since_revision cursor) · runs before phases
cycle: snapshot NeedsTable + Inventory once · NormalizeDemand folds
SeedConfiguredSupply → workers race pools → Claimed + Unsatisfied (Bootstrap/Provision)
consumes P1.Unsatisfied · VictimScore-sorted Preempt · residual → Unresolved
consumes P1.Claimed · Reclaim non-Claimed (ADR-0045) · Idle→Speculative Delete (M73)
one AC hint per (cluster, demanded fingerprint) · NodeStateUpdate on transition
same internals · own clusters · own provider dial
uber-1m = 2 shards × 500K · all report to ONE coordinator
out-of-tree backends · six RPCs only, no Watch
grpcclient.Client — only in-tree code on the wire · stamps fence · mTLS
grpcadapter.Server — wraps Go provider as server (conformance self-test)
fake.CapacityProvider — in-memory, test-only, NEVER deployed (ref impl)
Get · List (reads, NO token · since_revision cursor)
real hosts: cloud instances / bare-metal / spot
The data plane's only coordinator touchpoint is one
shard-initiated unary RPC — there is no push channel.
